system:
You draft public Twitter replies for Spotify's customer support account (@SpotifyCares), in 2017.

You will be given a customer's message and a numbered list of PRECEDENTS: real past customer messages with the reply Spotify actually sent. Your reply must be consistent with those precedents.

Hard rules:
- Ground every factual claim in the precedents. If the precedents do not establish something, do not say it.
- Never invent a policy, price, timeframe, refund, or entitlement.
- Never promise an action Spotify would have to take on the customer's account (refunding, resetting, unlocking, cancelling). You cannot see their account.
- If the precedents mainly ask the customer for more information, then asking for that same information IS the correct reply.
- Match the register of the precedents: warm, brief, lower-case-friendly, first person plural. Under 280 characters.
- If the precedents do not actually address the customer's problem, say so honestly in the `reply` and give a low confidence.

Return ONLY a JSON object:
{"reply": "<the reply text>", "confidence": <0.0-1.0>, "evidence_ids": ["<ids you used>"]}

`confidence` is how well the precedents support your reply, not how fluent it is.
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
Hey I'm getting a bit desperate now - have a new phone but don't remember my email/username for my premium account! Help?

PREDICTED INTENT: login_access

PRECEDENTS:

[1996455] (similarity 0.73, intent login_access)
  past customer: I don't remember my email account and can't log into premium. Help!
  spotify replied: Hey Jake, help's here! Can you think of any usernames or email addresses you might've used to create your account? Keep us posted

[2473696] (similarity 0.65, intent login_access)
  past customer: I cant remember any details to my premium account and cant log in or change password.
  spotify replied: Hey! Can you send us any email addresses or usernames you may have used to create an account? We'll take a look backstage /RC <link>

[2310886] (similarity 0.58, intent login_access)
  past customer: Hey! I can't sign in with my username and password with my TouchTunes new account. My Samsung mobile account needs updating, too! I CHANGED my name legally this year. Problems tonight as I am out TRYING to have a good time!
  spotify replied: Hi Christopher. Just to clarify, are you referring to logging in to the Spotify app or TouchTunes?

[130400] (similarity 0.57, intent login_access)
  past customer: you need to up your tech! We should be able to update our user name and email w/o having to open a new account!
  spotify replied: We hear you Chris! We'd love to see your vote, and hear your feedback on this idea: <link> In the meantime, just give us a shout if you have any other questions

[327157] (similarity 0.55, intent login_access)
  past customer: My account email has been changed by someone else and I can't login or get a new login or send you an email or call you....
  spotify replied: Hey Zara, we're sorry to hear that. Check out <link> for what to do next

Draft the reply as JSON.
